mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (current level) signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or average 20-day returns when FEDFUNDS is in the lowest quartile are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 3.5% signals tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 3.5% or Rank IC for the trigger is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) has Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-year window or negative returns are not observed when both series decline.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment (UNRATE > 0.3pp change in 3 months) combined with slowing job growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.5% in 3 months) signals labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 0.3pp change in 3mo AND PAYEMS growth < 0.5% in 3mo
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered periods or Rank IC for the trigger condition is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals real economy contraction, reducing corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-year rolling window for INDPRO as 60-day return predictor or average 60-day returns when INDPRO declines are not significantly negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts decline below 1500.0 thousand units signals weak consumer demand for housing, reducing economic activity and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when HOUST < 1500.0 or Rank IC for the trigger is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous inflation rise (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY) and stable/falling federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%) signals persistent inflationary pressures prompting central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction term (CPIAUCSL * FEDFUNDS) has Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-year window or negative returns are not observed when both conditions hold.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth > 2.0% and HOUST growth > 0.5% in last quarter), strong demand signals overheating triggering central bank hawkishness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 2.0% AND HOUST growth > 0.5% in last quarter
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered periods or Rank IC for the trigger condition is <0.03.
